tagline: The World's First Shelf-Stable, Plant-Based Sashimi.

.

.
Our breakthrough is our patented High Moisture High Nutrient Injection (HMHNI) technology

. Crucially, our process allows the product to be thermally stabilized directly in its packaging, granting it a full year of shelf life with zero refrigeration
.
By completely decoupling premium seafood from the cold chain, we achieve "Logistics Sovereignty"
. Our plant-based sashimi costs 40% less than traditional fish, enabling us to deliver unprecedented 75-85% gross margins for B2B operators
.
The market demand is deeply validated. In over 10,000 blind sensory tests, 8 out of 10 consumers preferred Bluana over conventional raw fish
. We have secured major B2B traction with signed Letters of Intent (LOIs) from global players desperate for ambient stability, including Japan Airlines, Selgros, and Poke House
.
We scale rapidly through an asset-light "Intel-Inside" model: driving direct B2B/D2C sales while licensing our HMHNI machinery and proprietary ingredient mixes to large co-packers
. Led by a team with 4 successful exits, Bluana is currently raising a $750K to $1M Seed round to commission our industrial pilot line and fulfill our commercial pipeline, targeting a €125M+ exit by 2030
.

FINX replaces that fragmentation with a modular, regulatory-native platform that unifies:

Orchestrated Onboarding (KYC/KYB/pKYC/IDV)

FinCrime & Risk Controls (AML, sanctions/PEP/adverse media, fraud signals, monitoring)

Case Management & Collaboration

Compliance Workflow Automation & Reporting

Policy-based transaction control (approvals, limits, orchestration) without processing or holding funds

FINX provides open APIs, SDKs, and white-label components so customers can adopt the full platform or deploy individual capabilities. FINX operates on top of existing banking/payment rails and partners, acting as the governance layer that enforces policies and compliance before execution.

FINX is SaaS, cloud-native, multi-tenant, multi-entity, multi-currency, and API-driven—built to accelerate compliant financial innovation by removing infrastructure bottlenecks so customers can focus on product and distribution.

name: BioUs Biotech
tagline: NanoPHA-AI: theranostic nanopolymer platform for cancer care
description:
BioUs Cancer Therapeutics is a precision oncology deep-tech company developing NanoPHA-AI®, a biodegradable theranostic biopolymer platform designed to improve how cancer drugs are delivered, monitored, and optimized.

Our core insight is that many oncology drugs do not fail because the molecule lacks activity, but because delivery is inefficient, non-specific, and difficult to track in real time. BioUs addresses this bottleneck through PHB/PHBV-based nanocapsules that encapsulate existing anticancer compounds, increase tumor-site accumulation, reduce systemic toxicity, support controlled release, and enable imaging-compatible biodistribution monitoring.

NanoPHA-AI® operates through four integrated functions: Scan → Target → Release → Monitor. This transforms a conventional drug carrier into a true theranostic system, combining therapy and diagnostics in one modular platform.

Our first translational application focuses on paclitaxel delivery for solid tumors, including triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), one of the most aggressive and difficult-to-treat cancer indications. However, the platform is not limited to one drug. It is designed as a co-development asset that can be adapted across multiple oncology payloads and strategic pharma partnerships.

Unlike traditional nanoparticle systems based on persistent synthetic polymers or lipid carriers, NanoPHA-AI® uses PHA biopolymers that are biodegradable, biocompatible, naturally derived, and aligned with the next generation of sustainable pharmaceutical materials. In parallel, BioUs is building a long-term AI-assisted optimization layer that will use delivery and performance data to improve future formulations through predictive modeling.

BioUs Cancer Therapeutics is not creating new drugs from scratch. We are building the delivery and diagnostic intelligence that can make existing oncology therapies safer, smarter, and more effective, without requiring pharma companies to redesign their drug pipelines.
differentiators: NanoPHA-AI® is a biodegradable PHA theranostic oncology platform with targeting, imaging, controlled release and AI design.

Our AI operates both in the cloud and at the edge—ideal for remote oilfields with intermittent connectivity.

The platform supports:

- Predictive maintenance with up to 70% cost reduction
- AI-powered environmental monitoring (computer vision: leak, intrusion, PPE detection)
- A Generative AI assistant (“StrattoChat”) to turn complex telemetry into insights
- SCADA/PLC integration with secure AWS-based infrastructure

We operate under a SaaS model, charging per operational unit (e.g., oil well, tank, or station) with flexible pricing and zero CAPEX requirements. This allows customers to modernize operations without replacing existing infrastructure.

StrattoGuard is currently in dev. Our goal is to modernize the +2 million under-automated oil wells globally, unlock deferred production, and help operators transition toward a low-emissions, digitally-optimized energy future.

name: LUFTCAR LLC.
tagline: LuftCar: Seamless air-ground mobility for faster, smarter transport
description:
LuftCar is an advanced mobility company developing a modular air-ground transportation platform designed to move people, cargo, and critical supplies faster and more efficiently across regional distances. The company’s core innovation is a patented docking system that allows an aircraft to carry and deploy a ground vehicle or modular cargo unit, reducing the need for multiple transfers between trucks, helicopters, and airports. By eliminating these handoffs, LuftCar significantly reduces door-to-door travel time, operational complexity, and infrastructure dependency.

Today, regional transport systems are fragmented. Cargo shipments often rely on trucks for short-to-mid distance routes, even when traffic congestion can add hours of delay. Medical transport frequently requires multiple handoffs between ambulances, helicopters, and hospitals. Emergency and disaster response operations similarly depend on complex coordination between airlift and ground logistics. These fragmented systems increase cost, slow response times, and create operational inefficiencies.

LuftCar addresses this challenge with an integrated mobility ecosystem. The company is developing a long-range aircraft capable of carrying a ground vehicle or modular payload unit using its patented docking architecture. This design enables seamless transitions between air and ground travel, allowing cargo, equipment, or emergency response vehicles to move as a single system rather than through multiple disconnected transport modes.

Beyond the aircraft itself, LuftCar is building a complete operational platform that includes deployable vertiport and energy hub infrastructure along with intelligent route planning software. The company’s LuftPAATH AI system analyzes demand patterns, route constraints, and infrastructure availability to help operators plan efficient missions and optimize regional mobility networks. This integrated approach enables faster deployment of advanced air mobility services while increasing utilization and reducing operational friction.

LuftCar’s platform is designed for several high-impact markets including medical transport, regional cargo logistics, disaster response, and defense mobility. These sectors require rapid response times, operational flexibility, and the ability to reach locations that may lack traditional airport infrastructure.
differentiators: LuftCar connects air and ground transport with a patented docking system, enabling faster door-to-door mobility without transfers.

tagline:
I am pleased to introduce you to ROC, a leader in advanced grease trap waste and fats, oil, and grease (FOG) separation technology. Our cutting-edge system is at the forefront of transforming waste management by efficiently capturing valuable brown grease oil while ensuring that the treated water maintains a Biological Oxygen Demand (B.O.D.) level below 250 parts per million, making it suitable for non-potable uses or drain disposal.
At ROC., we turn waste into wealth. We receive a tipping fee for every gallon of feedstock from grease trap collectors and haulers. Our state-of-the-art plant processes this waste by separating the water and solids and capturing high-value brown grease oil for additional revenue. We are happy to provide detailed forecasts on request.

Our facility is equipped to process up to 150,000 gallons of waste per day. On average, we capture 7,500 gallons of premium brown grease/oil daily, representing 5% of the total waste processed. This brown grease is highly sought after for its use in producing biofuels and jet fuels, contributing to significant reductions in carbon emissions. For instance, Virgin Airlines recently demonstrated the potential of such sustainable fuels by flying from London to New York using a blend of cooking oil, yellow grease, and brown grease, achieving a zero-carbon footprint. Brown grease also has diverse applications, including in cosmetics, pet food, industrial lubricants, and more.

Our technology addresses a critical global need by converting hazardous waste into a valuable commodity. This not only mitigates landfill contamination and illegal dumping but also reduces grease management costs for communities. By repurposing brown grease into eco-friendly fuels, we offer both economic and environmental benefits.

We are excited about the opportunity to share our detailed forecasts and business plans with you. ROC is positioned for substantial growth and is seeking investment partners who share our vision of transforming waste into wealth while advancing sustainable practices.

Thank you for considering ROC and our proposed site and forecasts as a potential investment opportunity. We have targeted cities in a addition to Orlando and will provide detailed forecasts upon request.
